name: PAX2 Semantic-ID Model (PLUM baseline)
method: Codebooks: the residual k-means of semantic_ids.py, fit on the training documents' serving-index embeddings only (corpus split 'train': not held out, not paid); held-out documents are assigned to the nearest centroid level by level, so no held-out vector shapes a codebook. Score: a held-out document's score is the outlier share of the training documents sharing its (c1, c2) cell; when that cell holds fewer than MIN_CELL training documents it backs off to the c1 cell. Benchmark: scripts/encoder/common.py's summarize() on the same held-out documents (data/generated/model/plum/ holdout.json, the holdout run 20261019-094112-train was judged on), pooled AUC and count-weighted within-channel AUC — the Gate E rows' protocol with the cell share in place of the 20-neighbor share.

gate.name: S
gate.rule: pooled AUC on the held-out channels above stock bge-m3 kNN-AUC 0.5775

codebooksNote: centroids are not stored; the cell table plus semantic_ids.py reproduce the model from the index and seed

attempts.rule: hard backoff: c1c2 cell when it holds 20+ training docs, else c1
c1c2 share shrunk toward the c1 share with 20 pseudo-documents

status: Gate S failed on both allowed attempts; recorded, not served
